To save on time and to test toggles and shaders, I use Gester Manager. Just add it to your project, then add it in the  hierarchy. Once you run your project and in “play” mode, switch it back to the editor and select the “Gester Manager” in the hierarchy and a menu should pop up in the inspector.

details:
I have a lot of users looking to quickly upload test avatars & maps without locking in their shaders. Having a way to identify when an upload is a test upload would allow people to insert debug data and lower performance shaders into test builds without allowing them to upload slow debug variants to the public servers.
My only other option is to allow players to upload without locking in which I honestly don't think players will use responsibly resulting in a massively laggy shader and game.
title: Add a hook for "Build & Test" uploads
